lede: The biggest thing to watch this week is San Miguel County's Planning Commission on November 12, where proposed changes to the Affordable Housing Impact Mitigation Fee are on the table alongside broader housing incentive ideas — decisions that shape whether workforce housing actually gets built here. Also worth your attention: the Ouray BOCC has two public hearings Tuesday, including a PUD land split and a budget amendment, and the Ouray Planning Commission takes up a proposed ordinance on natural medicine regulation. Closer to home, Monday's Open Space Commission is pressing for real data on the Valley Floor goat grazing pilot.

notable.stake: Commission reviews goat grazing data, costs, and wildlife impacts on Valley Floor.
